judgement.reason: Monica is a Laravel web app on PostgreSQL/MySQL with optional search services, so deploying with repository changes is a reasonable outcome.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unconfirmed service: the repository declares MEILISEARCH_URL in .env.example; TYPESENSE_HOST in .env.example. Deployz did not find how the application uses it.
reviews.reason: The shown lines do not include the MEILISEARCH_URL or TYPESENSE_HOST settings or a scout driver setting that would prove the search engines are optional, so the vendor should confirm whether production needs them.
